author: opencode-worker-8
text: Released 2026-09-10 worker8: current checkout has no C SOS TX caller. sos_post() in lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/coap_server.c is receive-side CoAP only; lichen_link_tx() in lichen/subsys/lichen/link/lichen_link_tx.c accepts IPv6 and hardcodes SCHC dispatch. The branch also predates the main-branch SOS classification header change. Completing this leaf requires a separate raw L2 SOS transmit API/refactor plus integration tests; no source changes made.
